name: Progress donut
description: A ring that fills to value out of max, with the percentage (or your own text) in the centre and a label; changes animate.

params.name: max
params.help: The full amount (100 for a percentage)

params.name: label
params.help: Line under the ring, e.g. Funded or Sprint done (empty: none)

params.name: centre
params.help: Text in the middle instead of the percentage, e.g. 34/50 (empty: the percentage)
